The Marin Museum of Bicycling & Mountain Bike Hall of Fame is Marin’s most unique event rental destination. Filled with bicycles and memorabilia from the 1860s to today’s latest, the space has abundant natural light and a high ceiling, with natural wood truss construction and skylights. Have fun and at the same time help support the mission of the museum
